why: The destructible share is read over the whole board instead of over the wall: `destructibleFraction` is a fraction of ALL cells, so a 10% wall that is 40% destructible reads 4% and passes the 30%-of-wall-mass ceiling it breaks.
killedBy: destructibles over wall mass (issue #1029) divides by the wall, not the board: 4% of the board is 40% of a 10% wall
runs: destructibles at most 30% of the wall mass (issue #1029) THE CONTROL: a board 40% destructible by wall cells is reported over the ceiling
